what: parse-rate-check replacement uses an invalid id grammar and an unsafe slot argument
scenario_or_breakage: `parse-rate-check` only accepts `finding-only` or `finding-oos`, so the planned `--id-grammar "FINDING"` exits 2 under `set -e`; the non-three-slot branch also has no initialized `slot` under `set -u`, so adding `--slot "$slot"` there can abort tallying
suggested_fix: Use `--id-grammar finding-oos`; in the legacy else branch either omit `--slot` or enumerate voter files with an initialized slot/tool label before calling `parse-rate-check`
